title: Monitoring dashboards for country programme results
need: Country teams report results in 40 spreadsheets that headquarters consolidates by hand each quarter, which takes about three weeks and delays portfolio reviews.
objective: One application where country teams enter results once and managers see portfolio dashboards the same day.
scope: Application development on the organisation's cloud platform: data entry forms, validation rules, role-based access, three management dashboards, handover and training. Out of scope: changing the results framework.

deliverables.item: Clickable prototype validated with three country teams
Release 1 in production for pilot countries

qualifications: Team with delivered public-sector data applications on the same cloud platform.
